title: Osun Leaders Launch 26 Subcommittees to Boost Tinubu’s 2027 Campaign
excerpt: Osun’s governor and cross‑party leaders set up 26 subcommittees to rally support for President Bola Tinubu’s re‑election bid.
body:
In a lively gathering in Osun State, Governor Ademola Adeleke kicked off a new phase of political organizing aimed at President Bola Tinubu’s 2027 re‑election campaign. The event, reported by Premium Times Nigeria, saw the inauguration of 26 subcommittees tasked with handling everything from voter outreach to logistics.

## Cross‑party teamwork drives the effort
The subcommittees bring together political figures from the Accord Party, the All Progressives Congress (APC) and the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP). This broad alliance reflects a strategic move to pool resources and influence across party lines, ensuring a unified front for Tinubu’s campaign in Osun.

## Aiming for 1.5 million votes
During the meeting of the Osun State Presidential Campaign Council, participants reviewed mobilisation strategies and set an ambitious target: securing at least 1.5 million votes for Tinubu in the state. The newly formed committees will coordinate grassroots activities, rally organization, and voter education to hit that goal.

## What the subcommittees will do
Each of the 26 groups will focus on a specific aspect of the electioneering process—ranging from community outreach and media engagement to fundraising and volunteer coordination. By dividing responsibilities, the campaign hopes to run a smoother, more effective operation as the 2027 presidential race approaches.

The inauguration marks a significant step for Tinubu’s supporters in Osun, signaling both confidence and determination as the political calendar moves toward the next national election.

sources.title: Adeleke inaugurates 26 subcommittees for Tinubu’s re-election campaign in Osun
